claim: route._twice and deep._twice (src/thinkhow/facilitation/deep.py:232-240) apply the same rule step by step: call, retry once on a pydantic ValidationError, raise FacilitationError on the second failure, with an unreachable AssertionError at the end. Only the message text differs, so a change to the retry rule would have to be made in both places.

evidence.detail: for attempt in (1, 2): try call(); on ValidationError at attempt 2 raise FacilitationError('the router's answer stayed invalid after one retry')
the same loop, the same exception, the same docstring; the message is 'the deep cycle's answer stayed invalid after one retry'
settle._retry is a different rule (no loop, a single attempt), so it is not part of this finding
